entities.summary: Gülıshan Saifulinqyzy Nahbaeva is a chess player from Kazakhstan. She received the FIDE titles of Woman Grandmaster (WGM) in 2012 and International Master (IM) in 2018. Guliskhan Nakhbayeva was a journalists & chroniclers from Shymkent (b. 1991-06-20, Shymkent). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
